capabilities: Share notes, folders or passages with agents through local links
Let agents follow wikilinks for related context
Write agent results back into the vault as Markdown notes
Record which notes and agents were used in a knowledge profile
Connect an agent by installing a Skill
disambiguation: Not an in-app AI chat or note generator; it exposes your notes to external agents through a local HTTP service.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.8.7+ on macOS, Windows or Linux); share links work only on the same computer and the vault must stay open while an agent works; mobile offers a read-only dashboard and history viewer; no cloud account required; activity figures in the screenshots are demo data.
problem: AI agents running outside Obsidian cannot read vault notes as context or write what they produce back into the vault.
